directive: Production enemy archetype registry, tactical scaling budgets, and AI profile coverage for solo-Titan missions.

archetypes.counterplay: Area control, hazard baiting, cleave, execution routing.

archetypes.purpose: Force stance discipline and terrain planning.
archetypes.counterplay: Dodge charge lanes, parry windows, armor break, displacement.

aiProfile.counterplay: Dodge charge lanes, parry windows, armor break, displacement.

archetypes.purpose: Threaten from range and punish exposed paths.
archetypes.counterplay: Line-of-sight breaks, pursuit reactions, high-ground denial.

aiProfile.telegraph: Drawn spectral sightline one turn before focus fire.
aiProfile.counterplay: Break line of sight, pursue, deny high ground.

archetypes.purpose: Restrict movement and disrupt clean objective routes.
archetypes.counterplay: Cleanse zones, destroy anchors, shift stance, terrain immunity builds.

aiProfile.telegraph: Ground sigil blooms before root or hazard lock.
aiProfile.counterplay: Shift stance, cleanse zones, destroy anchors.

archetypes.purpose: Attack Momentum, Divinity, cooldowns, and reactions.

aiProfile.counterplay: Interrupt casts, prioritize, execute before drain resolves.

archetypes.purpose: Protect bosses, rituals, exits, and high-value threats.

aiProfile.telegraph: Shield plant and aura pulse before intercept.

archetypes.purpose: Make low-health Titan states dangerous without cheap instant death.
archetypes.counterplay: Guard stance, preemptive kill, concealment, Divine Ascension reset.

aiProfile.telegraph: Execution mark appears before finisher path.
aiProfile.counterplay: Guard stance, conceal, preemptive kill, Ascension reset.

archetypes.purpose: Single mechanic-focused enemy that changes how the room is solved.

archetypes.purpose: Mini-boss duel embedded inside a larger battlefield.

missionLevelTemplate.dynamicAllowance: repeatable variants may flex within +/-10% power, never beyond tier caps

runtimeRules: Every creature must declare combatRole and aiProfile.archetype.
Every creature combatRole must resolve to a production archetype.
Scaling adds behavior, composition, hazards, and phases before raw health inflation.
Campaign missions keep fixed bands so old victories remain proof of growth.
Endgame dynamic scaling is capped and must stay telegraphed.
acceptanceEvidence: All 18 creatures carry combatRole and aiProfile coverage.
All 10 design archetypes have AI decision loops, target priorities, telegraphs, and counterplay.
All difficulty tiers expose explicit composition/hazard/reaction budgets.
Release validation rejects missing creature AI profiles, unknown archetypes, and missing budget tiers.
